raw_text: Significant ceasefire violation reported in Poonch sector along the LoC. This is the first major breach of the Feb 2021 ceasefire understanding between India and Pakistan. Small arms and mortar exchanges ongoing for several hours. Three border villages evacuated. Worth watching if this is an isolated incident or signals deterioration of the bilateral ceasefire.
